0: City of Santa Claus, Georgia Ordinance (Property Survey Required) The Council of the City of Santa Claus hereby ordains; 1. No new construction shall be allowed, nor shall any structure or structures, be moved onto property located within the boundaries of the City as they now exist, or may hereafter exist, nor shall additions or modifications to existing structure or structures, be allowed until a survey of property to be used is conducted by a licensed Land Surveyor licensed to conduct such surveys by the State of Georgia. 2. Requirements of this ordinance may be waived if property corner markers are in place, and were no place by a surveyor as defined in section one, and are agreed upon by all adjoining property owners. 3. No Building Permit shall be issued by the City of Santa Claus until all requirements of this ordinance have been complied with. 4. This ordinance supersedes any and all prior ordinances, if such exist, pertaining to the subject, or subjects, contained herein.
